blind.description: A freestanding cylindrical iron gibbet or torture cage with a domed top and a top suspension ring. Heavy curved vertical bars are secured by horizontal riveted bands, with a hinged door latch on the front. At the bottom, it rests on small splayed metal feet, and inside on the floor of the cage sits an off-white human skull. The metal has a dark weathered iron texture with subtle edge highlights.
blind.from_above: A circular dome with radial iron bars converging like wheel spokes toward a central metallic ring/loop.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 feet tall (around 85-90% of the figure's height) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide across the feet.
